messages.content: I am the mother , write a mail to student affair sir abhay pawar for requesting the swap of the hostel with the other student who got the hostel in suhrc as I got in sit

Here’s a professional and polite draft of the email you can send:

---

**Subject:** Request for Hostel Swap with Another Student

Dear Sir Abhay Pawar,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am the mother of [Your Full Name], who has been allotted hostel accommodation in SIT. I am writing to kindly request your support in allowing a mutual swap of hostel allocation between my child and another student who has been allotted a room in SUHRC. Both students are willing and in agreement to this exchange.

We believe this change would be beneficial for personal and logistical reasons, and we assure you that there are no objections from either side.

I kindly request you to consider this swap and guide us on the formal process to make it possible.

Thank you for your time and understanding.

Warm regards,  
[Your Full Name]  
Mother of [Student’s Full Name]  
[Your Contact Number]  
[Optional: Email ID]

---
